note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: FY26 deficit $1.992T (5-yr high, ~6.2% GDP); Sept -$26.9B beat. New: Graham Act EO — +500% RU, +100% top oil buyers from Oct 18, all waived. France Oct 20 vote, Moody's Oct 23; OAT-Bund 135.2bp.
fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk

growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: Week's scorecard final: US IP +0.7% beat vs NY Fed services -20.7 warning; UK GDP +0.1% beat (2.1% y/y); NZ PMI 56.5. Next: China Q3 GDP, Canada/US housing and Canada CPI Monday.
growth.title: Growth differentials

inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: Hot week stands: US CPI 3.7%, PPI +1.3%, import prices +1.1% (+8.1% y/y, 4-yr high). Eurozone CPI 3.8% confirmed (energy +18.9%). WTI >$100 — the energy kicker into every Oct/Nov meeting.
inflation.title: Inflation

policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: The Fed went silent Saturday — October locked as a hold (~85% Friday), December the debate. ECB: no October hike priced, December 100%. BoC Oct 28 live (Macklem + WTI >$100); BoE Nov 5; RBNZ Oct 28 two-way; BoJ Oct 29-30. New wildcard: the Graham Act EO (Oct 18 tripwire).
policy.title: Policy divergence

positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: No new COT until Friday. Hedge funds net LONG AUD (79th pctile) — squeeze thesis broken. Dollar 54th, euro 44th, yen 67th, franc 41st, CAD 31st — none crowded (CFTC TFF, Oct 6).
positioning.title: Positioning

risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Relief Friday (DXY first weekly fall in five); armed weekend — Trump gave Iran 'more time' but MT ST 3 was confirmed hit in Hormuz, Embassy Jerusalem on authorized departure, Graham Act tripwire Oct 18.
risk.title: Risk sentiment

tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Nov WTI $100.71 (+2.8%), Dec Brent $109.28 (+3.2%); Brent-WTI ~$10.7 = wide geopolitical premium. Caps: IEA 100M-bbl release, shadow-fleet easing talk, Starshield pressure on Kyiv.
tot.title: Terms of trade
